import json, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap; repo = pathlib.Path.cwd();

def write_project(name, source):
    root = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix=f'fozzylang-{name}-'))
    (root / 'src').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (root / 'fozzy.toml').write_text(textwrap.dedent(f'''\
        [package]
        name="{name}"
        version="0.1.0"

        [[target.bin]]
        name="{name}"
        path="src/main.fzy"
    '''))
    (root / 'src/main.fzy').write_text(textwrap.dedent(source))
    return root

def verify(name, source, expect_rc):
    root = write_project(name, source)
    proc = subprocess.run(['cargo', 'run', '-q', '-p', 'fz', '--', 'verify', str(root), '--json'], cwd=str(repo), capture_output=True, text=True)
    payload = json.loads(proc.stdout.strip())
    assert proc.returncode == expect_rc, (name, proc.returncode, payload, proc.stderr)
    return payload

def messages(payload):
    return [item['message'] for item in payload['items']]

mut_then_shared = verify('mut_then_shared', '''
    fn main() -> i32 {
        let x: i32 = 1
        let unique: &'a mut i32 = x
        let shared: &'a i32 = x
        discard unique
        discard shared
        return 0
    }
''', 1)
assert any('creates shared borrow `shared` from owner `x` while mutable borrowed reference `unique` is still live' in message for message in messages(mut_then_shared)), mut_then_shared
assert not any('call signature mismatch' in message for message in messages(mut_then_shared)), mut_then_shared

shared_then_mut = verify('shared_then_mut', '''
    fn main() -> i32 {
        let x: i32 = 1
        let shared: &'a i32 = x
        let unique: &'a mut i32 = x
        discard shared
        discard unique
        return 0
    }
''', 1)
assert any('creates mutable borrow `unique` from owner `x` while shared borrowed reference `shared` is still live' in message for message in messages(shared_then_mut)), shared_then_mut
assert not any('call signature mismatch' in message for message in messages(shared_then_mut)), shared_then_mut

mut_then_shared_call = verify('mut_then_shared_call', '''
    fn inspect(v: &'a i32) -> i32 {
        discard v
        return 0
    }
    fn main() -> i32 {
        let x: i32 = 1
        let unique: &'a mut i32 = x
        discard inspect(x)
        discard unique
        return 0
    }
''', 1)
assert any('creates shared borrow of owner `x` via `inspect(x)` while mutable borrowed reference `unique` is still live' in message for message in messages(mut_then_shared_call)), mut_then_shared_call
assert not any('call signature mismatch for `inspect`' in message for message in messages(mut_then_shared_call)), mut_then_shared_call

process_builders_clean = verify('process_builders_clean', '''
    use core.proc;
    fn main() -> i32 {
        let argv = proc.argv_new()
        discard proc.argv_push(argv, "hi")
        let env = proc.env_new()
        discard proc.env_set(env, "K", "V")
        let handle = proc.spawn_cmd("echo", argv, env, "")
        discard proc.close(handle)
        return 0
    }
''', 0)
assert process_builders_clean['errors'] == 0, process_builders_clean
assert not any('linear value `argv` was not consumed/freed' in message for message in messages(process_builders_clean)), process_builders_clean
assert not any('linear value `env` was not consumed/freed' in message for message in messages(process_builders_clean)), process_builders_clean

print('compiler-memory-borrow-exclusivity-ok')
